source.title: HiRISE PSP_001752_1750_RED_A_01_ORTHO — 518 m orthorectified crop (DTM DTEEC_001488_1750_001752_1750_U02)

limitations: Orthoimage crop centred near 4.84°S, 137.30°E on lower Mount Sharp, Gale crater; exact boxwork target and rover/science-site overlap are unverified.
Planar distance is measured in the Mars equirectangular map plane (standard parallel 0°); east-west lengths read about 0.4 % long at this latitude.
Elevation comes from a 1 m HiRISE stereo DTM tied to MOLA; the provider states no accuracy figure and lists possible artifacts (processing boxes, CCD seams, faceted low-contrast areas).
Terrain suggestions use sampled grid-segment grades only. No hazard, obstacle-clearance, traction or safety assessment is made.
Missions saved on the earlier image (hirise-psp001752-red-center-2048-025m-v2) are preserved but do not load on this image; coordinates are not migrated.
Science records and historical REMS excerpt are regional context, not verified measurements at the drawn route.

calibration.method: 2048x2048 window of the provider orthoimage (orthorectified on HiRISE DTM DTEEC_001488_1750_001752_1750_U02), provider 8-bit values, no resampling. Equirectangular Mars sphere R=3396.19 km, centre longitude 137.3°. Distances are planar map lengths; terrain routing uses the accepted DTM package.
